tracks.name: 01-forest-whispers
tracks.prompt: Original instrumental high-fidelity orchestral dark fantasy real-time strategy game score. D minor, exactly 96 BPM, steady 4/4 time, medieval forest of witches and orcs. Natural acoustic orchestra, dark strings, clear woodwinds, rich French horns and hand drums. A memorable four-note D-F-E-A melodic motif that develops into new phrases. Musically composed, varied motifs and harmonic movement, not a repetitive ambient loop. No singing, no vocals, no choir, no electronics, no EDM, no rock guitars, no artificial trailer impacts. Wide dynamic range with space for game dialogue and sound effects. A beautiful eerie but inviting melody; serious ancient magical forest atmosphere, quietly compelling and emotional. Start very soft with distant solo flute, bowed strings and harp. After the introduction establish a gently propulsive bass and plucked strings pulse, then a distinct new melodic theme. Explore contrasting woodwind and warm horn countermelodies with a strong memorable musical hook. Build to a restrained epic orchestral passage, then return to subtle mystery at the ending. Clearly differentiated sections and development every 25 to 40 seconds. Never settle into a repeating four-bar ostinato. Make a full instrumental composition for exploration.
